gaps.sentence: ___ bicycles are a cheap way of seeing the city.
gaps.explanation: Plural nouns in a general sense take no article.

gaps.sentence: He spent three years in ___ United States.
His mother went to ___ prison to visit him.
gaps.explanation: Visitors go to the building: 'went to the prison'.

gaps.sentence: ___ Himalayas are among the youngest mountains on Earth.
gaps.explanation: Ranges like 'the Himalayas' take 'the'; single peaks take no article.

gaps.sentence: He is ___ most experienced teacher in the school.
gaps.explanation: Superlative + of/in-phrase: the most experienced teacher in the school.

gaps.sentence: They're building ___ new library near the town hall.
gaps.explanation: A new library — first mention; the town hall is the known one.

gaps.sentence: This is ___ second time you've been late this week.
She's got ___ few friends in Madrid, so she visits often.
gaps.explanation: 'A few' means some (positive); 'few' alone means hardly any.
